summary: NCR Atleos filed an 8-K disclosing shareholder lawsuits challenging its pending merger with Brink's. Two complaints filed June 10-11, 2026 in NY Supreme Court allege negligent misrepresentation and concealment in the NCR Atleos proxy statement. The merger agreement, dated February 26, 2026, contemplates NCR Atleos becoming a wholly owned subsidiary of Brink's via two sequential mergers. Special meetings for shareholder votes are scheduled June 30, 2026. No deal terms (price, premium) are restated. Watch for litigation outcome, potential supplemental disclosures, or injunction risk ahead of the vote. Risk-arb spread may widen on litigation headlines.
